title: New Agent Checklist
description: Repository-level checklist for authoring a conformant TAO package. Follows docs/package-spec.md and ends by running the conformance tests and regenerating the registry index.

constraints: - You MUST read docs/package-spec.md in full before creating anything
- You MUST identify the required files and directories for a package (section 2)
- You SHOULD copy the structure of an existing package such as agents/system-sentinel/
rail.validation: List the required files and directories you will create, and confirm the package type (agent or team).

constraints: - You MUST create agents/<name>/agent.yaml (or team.yaml for a team) with a single top-level key
- You MUST include the identity, authority, inputs/outputs, state, operating model, recovery, local_adapter, compatibility, lifecycle and telemetry sections
- You MUST verify the file parses as YAML, e.g. `python3 -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]))" agents/<name>/agent.yaml`
- For a team, you MUST declare objective, lead, members, orchestration (workflow, shared_state, budgets, failure_policy) and result_contract
rail.validation: Report that the manifest parses as YAML and that every required field is present.

constraints: - You MUST write SYSTEM.md: identity, mission, scope, non-negotiable boundaries and failure modes
- You MUST reference SOPs and the operating loop rather than duplicating procedures inline
- You MUST keep it loadable as a system prompt without excessive token cost
rail.validation: Summarise the authority boundaries declared in SYSTEM.md and confirm they match the manifest.

constraints: - You MUST create the operating-loop taskrail at taskrails/<name>.taskrail.json
- Each task MUST carry constraints (MUST/SHOULD/MAY) and a validation gate
- You MUST create an induction taskrail at onboarding/induction.taskrail.json
- You MUST document the methodology in sops/
rail.validation: Confirm both taskrails parse as JSON and that every task has constraints and a validation string.

constraints: - You MUST make every script deterministic and read-only unless the package declares mutation authority
- Any mutating script MUST default to dry-run and enforce an explicit approval gate
- Scripts MUST emit machine-readable (JSON) output and fail loudly
- Scripts MUST NOT select accounts, targets or regions implicitly
rail.validation: Report the scripts you added and, for any mutating script, the exact approval gate it enforces.

constraints: - You MUST provide tests/run_all.sh
- You MUST cover boundary, authority, evidence and failure behaviour (and team handoffs for a team)
- You MUST ensure the suite exits non-zero on failure
rail.validation: Run the suite and report that it passes. Paste the summary line.

constraints: - You MUST run the repository conformance tests: `python3 tests/validate_packages.py`
- You MUST regenerate the registry index: `python3 scripts/build_index.py`
- You SHOULD run the full repository suite: `bash tests/run_all.sh`
rail.validation: Report zero conformance errors and that tao.json now lists the new package.
